reference.question: \(\triangle ABC\) is translated \(3\text{ cm}\) in the direction of \(BC\) to obtain \(\triangle DEF\) (points \(B,C,E,F\) lie on the same line, and \(BC=10\text{ cm}\)). Find the lengths of \(BF\) and \(EC\). (Answer in this order, separated by a comma; unit: cm.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Add and subtract collinear segments

\(BE=CF=3\), \(BF=BC+CF=10+3=13\); \(EC=BC-BE=10-3=7\).
